math: T_k is one variable per count k, shared for all request q and all deviation labels b. Each selected actual child pays u_a(q)>=T_k; each chosen hostile child pays u_b(d)<=T_k. Reverse construction chooses a minimum credible child independently per b and then T_k=max_b min_{d in R(k+e_b)}u_b(d); every realizable requested q has an action a with u_a(q)>=T_k. Actual-action q may differ from its minimum hostile child, and this is harmless: that alternative action is not taken at the same history. Unfolding uses ordered history plus requested q, not a common action per k. Domain keeps W(q0)=1, nonnegative joint masses, p,m>=1 and valid requested terminal. M=m follows s_a<=m from root IC; cap1 from all players is stronger but not needed.
